findings.message: Criterion 3 is only partly met. findings.paved_road: Add a test for each case. Resolve the P0 report, then re-enter and assert no new report and reports==1. Force a segment roll before the crossing and assert the trip is recovered. Write occurrences with no trip, then re-enter and assert exactly one trip and one report. Write a trip with no report, then re-enter and assert one report and no second trip.

findings.message: Criterion 4 is only partly met. Unbound enqueue is covered only by checking that no journal file exists.
